findings.title: Account data deserialised by hand with no discriminator distinguishing types
findings.fix: Use `Account<'info, T>`, or add a type tag as the first field and compare it before trusting the rest.

findings.title: Introspected instruction never checked against an expected program id
findings.fix: Compare `ix.program_id` with the program you expect before trusting the instruction.

findings.title: PDA seeds not anchored to a program-owned namespace literal
findings.fix: Prefix seeds with byte literals (b"...") unique to your program; avoid fully user-controlled seeds.

findings.title: unwrap()/expect() on account/instruction data - panic DoS
findings.fix: Use `try_from`/`Deref` with error propagation instead of unwrap on external input.
